name: DeFi TVL contraction beyond price -> capital-leaving-protocols short (ETH)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the two long TVL variants: this trades the DOWNSIDE of the de-beta'd deposit signal — TVL FALLING faster than price explains means real capital is being WITHDRAWN from protocols, deleveraging that leads ETH weakness): the same leakage caveat applies inverted — a TVL drop that is JUST ETH price falling is beta, but TVL contracting while price has NOT yet fallen (ret_Nd still non-negative) isolates genuine deposit outflow / protocol de-risking that precedes ETH downside. Short ETH; exit on TVL stabilizing (cross_up) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1 (most likely): if de-beta'd TVL outflow has no forward power on ETH, it is beta and dies. DISCONFIRMER 2: shorting ETH can blow the DD cap in a squeeze; KILL if maxDD>25%. DISCONFIRMER 3: if a plain negative-momentum short matches it, TVL adds nothing; and DefiLlama recounts can fake outflows -> require PIT TVL. High death probability — a symmetry test. Net of fees, DSR>=0.95.
catalyst: TVL deposits withdrawn faster than price falls (protocol de-risking)
